The top portion shows a blue header with stylized text.

artifact_observations.location: Top blue banner and central white label strip
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text in the top blue banner ('IOQI', 'Moo') and the central label strip consists of nonsensical, malformed characters and symbols that do not form real words. This is a classic AI generation artifact where text structure is mimicked but semantics fail.
The edges of the white label strip appear slightly soft and bleed into the beige casing, lacking the crisp physical boundary expected of a paper label on plastic.
The rectangular slots at the bottom vary inconsistently in shape and depth; some appear as shallow divots while others are deep holes, lacking the uniform molding precision of a manufactured object.
